# Dhaka AD

> 360° outdoor advertising agency in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Plans, books, produces and proves outdoor campaigns: LED billboards (56 screens in 10 cities), 44 static, expressway, tri-vision, neon and mid-island billboard positions across Dhaka, Dhaka Metro Rail in-coach screens (840 screens, ~550,000 daily commuters), Hazrat Shahjalal airport arrivals LED sign, events and LED wall rental, store opening activations, newspaper inserts, large-format printing, P4/P5 LED installation and digital marketing.

Phone: +880 1840 860 284 · Email: info@dhakaad.com · Address: House 5, Flat 5(A), Road 13, DIT Project, Badda, Dhaka, Bangladesh

Rates are not published because they change weekly with demand and season; they are given on request by phone.

## Key facts
- Static billboards in Dhaka are usually rented by the year; printing, installation, VAT, tax and AIT are quoted separately.
- LED billboards are sold per minute of daily airtime per screen, typically with a 60-minute daily minimum; creative is usually MP4 at 1920×1080.
- Metro rail in-coach screen campaigns run for 30 days; approved content is due about five days before airing.
- The airport domestic arrivals LED sign (7' × 5') runs 7am–11pm and is rented yearly.
- Static billboard artwork is due about 72 hours before installation.

## Billboard areas
- [Badda, Jolshiri & Purbachal 300 Feet](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/badda-purbachal/): New-town homeowners, property buyers, Gulshan–Badda commuters, Pragati Sarani traffic
- [Gulshan, Banani & Mohakhali](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/gulshan-banani-mohakhali/): Corporate decision-makers, airport traffic, premium shoppers, expressway users
- [Dhanmondi, New Market & Hatirpool](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/dhanmondi-new-market/): Students, families, fashion and electronics shoppers, coaching-centre traffic
- [Farmgate, Bijoy Sarani, Shahbagh & Paribagh](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/farmgate-shahbagh/): Cross-city commuters, university and hospital traffic, office workers
- [Motijheel, Gulistan & Old Dhaka](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/motijheel-old-dhaka/): Wholesalers, traders, bank and office commuters, launch passengers from the south
- [Mirpur, Agargaon & Darus Salam](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/mirpur/): Residential families, metro passengers, Mirpur-10 shoppers, Agargaon office traffic
- [Mohammadpur & Bosila](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/mohammadpur/): Mohammadpur residents, Keraniganj and south-west commuters, housing buyers
- [Malibagh, Khilgaon & Banasree](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/malibagh-khilgaon-banasree/): Residential families, local shoppers, Rampura–Hatirjheel commuters
- [Keraniganj & the Dhaka–Mawa–Bhanga Expressway](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/keraniganj/): Long-distance travellers, southern-district commuters, freight and bus traffic
- [Savar, Ashulia, Amin Bazar & Dhamrai](https://ahmedmasum2000000.github.io/dhaka-ad-website/static-billboards/savar-ashulia/): Garment and EPZ workforce, highway travellers, north-west bus traffic
